findings.reason: ELF concentrations and mg BASE/kg dose basis are stated, but ELF total/unbound concentration basis and formulation are NOT_FOUND. The total-concentration statement in A224 and fu in A225 explicitly concern plasma. Transferring them to ELF would introduce an unsupported relationship.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported ELF concentration-basis and formulation definitions, or an explicit unresolved limitation retained through compatibility review before QC. Keep plasma, BALF and ELF definitions separate.

findings.reason: A223 reports caption mean+/-SD, n>=3 and methods n=4/time; A219 says no SD or individual IDs were recovered. These statements do not provide numeric variability or verified counts for each digitized mean. Marker labels identify plotted points rather than animals.
findings.needed_material: Retain both count statements and the unrecovered-SD limitation. Confirm any point-specific counts or variability only from authorized source evidence; do not infer repeated animals, individual trajectories or interindividual variability.

findings.reason: The table provides nominal Time (h) and a separate approximate Pixel time (h), while A218 anchors administration at time 0 and A222 describes terminal samples. Actual collection times and any cross-time animal identities are NOT_FOUND. Pixel-derived times do not establish actual collection times.
findings.needed_material: Retain the two time columns separately and document the selected time representation during preparation. Obtain actual sampling-time definitions only if required by the downstream modeling design; otherwise carry their unknown status.

findings.reason: The supplied page supports a mouse pulmonary group-mean input at one IT dose with terminal samples. It does not establish requested model outputs, parameter identifiability, a held-out prediction design or human extrapolation validity. Adequacy requiring fitting remains unassessed.
findings.needed_material: Downstream animal PK review of the intended mouse ELF outputs, compatible inputs and any design-supported prediction assessment, retaining the group-summary and digitization limitations.

findings.reason: The page contains an ancillary same-study plasma fu=0.046 assay-based mean without numeric uncertainty. This is relevant binding evidence, but no binding-specific requirement is assigned here and the note explicitly excludes application to ELF.
findings.needed_material: Independent routing review of this text-only plasma-binding input, preserving its matrix, reported mean status, missing uncertainty and restriction against application to ELF.

findings.reason: A224, A226 and A227 include plasma, BALF, IV ELF and IT8.24 plasma context beyond the IT 4.12 ELF body records. IV ELF all-BLQ status and source-model outlier locations are not measurements or exclusion flags for this curve. The outlier locations are source-model-derived context subject to the benchmark restriction.
findings.needed_material: Preserve these notes with their stated matrices and regimens. Independently review routing of the source-model-derived outlier annotations before any use; do not use them to filter this curve or determine primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.
